topic: S3 bucket setup for analytics testing
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the technical requirements for setting up a dedicated environment (sandbox) for analytics testing. Currently, the sandbox uses a production S3 bucket, which is deemed suboptimal.

It was proposed that a separate infrastructure be created, including:
*   A new S3 bucket specifically for the sandbox.
*   Associated CloudFront distribution pointing to this new bucket.
*   An API user/endpoint to handle asset uploads (images) from analytics data into the dedicated bucket.

The current analytics system reportedly only interacts with buckets via CloudFront, suggesting that direct bucket access is not yet implemented.
decisions: A separate S3 bucket and CloudFront distribution will be created for the sandbox environment.
action_items: Someone needs to develop the 'build leader' functionality (related to analytics/backend).
